parsed_json.up: Select the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc_chembl_id. Left join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return one row per compound record, preserving duplicates if present. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending.
